Docket 1.3.74

**The watchlist keeps the report it ran.**

A scheduled check has always produced a full audit and then kept only a compact
record of it — enough to draw the trend line and say what changed, and not
enough to read. So the one thing monitoring could not give you was the thing an
audit is for.

Now every check keeps its report, and the site's page has a **Latest report**
section: when it ran, **View report**, and downloads as PDF, HTML or JSON. The
buttons show only the formats that particular check actually produced, and the
filename carries the date the check ran rather than today's.

Only the most recent report per site is kept, and the stored JSON leaves out the
page list — it is replaced on every check, and a large crawl would otherwise
take up a great deal of room for a file almost nobody opens. Every finding is in
it.

Sites already on your watchlist will show a report after their next check. A
report can only be made while the audit is still in memory, so there is nothing
to recover for checks that have already run.

**The app has some depth to it.**

The window had a flat ground, cards with a gradient too shallow to see, and the
brand colour in two places. It now has light coming from somewhere: a lit ground,
cards that read as objects, a glow on the score, and an accent on every section
heading. One secondary text colour was lightened to stay above the contrast
standard against the new card gradient.
